G05 Idempotency Duplicate, retried, reordered, and replayed events do not create duplicate end-recipient communications. G06 Supersession Newer states suppress contradictory queued messages and preserve the correct audit outcome. G07 Financial accuracy Amount, currency, balance, tax, date, document version, allocation, and status match the source of truth. G15 Secrets protection No secret, token, full card or bank data, raw payload, complete IP, or exploitable diagnostic appears.
